title: API Gateway Integration, Proxy Routing & Health Probing

test_cases.name: Gateway configuration & route validation
test_cases.input_setup: Configure APIM_GATEWAY_URL in environment and validate URI structure
test_cases.expected_result: Gateway endpoint URL cleanly parsed with valid HTTPS scheme
test_cases.evidence: Gateway route configured and validated: https://medvoice-apim.azure-api.net

test_cases.name: Gateway health probe latency bound
test_cases.input_setup: Execute gateway health check probe against backend components
test_cases.expected_result: Backend probe returns healthy with latency < 100 ms

test_cases.name: Gateway XML policy structural integrity
test_cases.input_setup: Parse apim/policies/global.xml and inspect XML schema hierarchy
test_cases.expected_result: Well-formed XML containing inbound, backend, outbound, and on-error nodes
test_cases.evidence: APIM global.xml policy is structurally valid with all required execution phases

test_cases.name: Proxy header forwarding validation
test_cases.input_setup: Forward client request through gateway proxy headers
test_cases.expected_result: X-Forwarded-For and X-Request-Id headers preserved through proxy pipeline
test_cases.evidence: Gateway proxy headers (X-Forwarded-For, X-Request-Id) preserved cleanly

test_cases.name: Backend outage resilience and 503 response
test_cases.input_setup: Simulate backend service interruption and measure gateway failure response
test_cases.expected_result: Gateway returns 503 Service Unavailable immediately without hanging
test_cases.evidence: Gateway returned HTTP 503 within 0.00ms on backend failure; zero hang
